programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set "within the architecture of the mind." Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).

programme.title: The Town
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Ben Affleck writes, directs and stars in this crime drama/romance. Based on the novel The Prince of Thieves by Chuck Hogan, Affleck's film follows a career criminal (Affleck) who finds himself romantically involved with the manager of a bank (Rebecca Hall) he held up. A high-stakes love triangle develops when an equally infatuated FBI agent (Mad Men's Jon Hamm) arrives in the pursuit of justice. Stolen cash and a stolen heart lead to a relationship that could destroy this prince of thieves.

programme.title: War Dogs
programme.desc: The Wolf of Wall Street's Jonah Hill and Whiplash's Miles Teller star in this dramedy based on a true story that follows two twenty-something Miami stoners who exploit a little-known government initiative during the Iraq War that allows small businesses to bid on U.S. Military contracts. Starting small, they begin raking in big money and are soon living the high life. But the pair gets in over their heads when they land a $300 million deal to arm the Afghan Military -- a deal that puts them in business with some very shady people, not the least of which turns out to be the U.S. Government. Comedy powerhouse Todd Phillips (The Hangover films) writes, directs and produces (with Bradley Cooper) this incredible true story based on a controversial Rolling Stone article.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guillermo del Toro (Pan's Labyrinth) brings out the big guns in this sci-fi action epic about a ragtag band of humans that band together in the year 2025 to fight legions of monstrous creatures rising from the sea. Using massive piloted robots to combat the alien threat, earth's survivors (including Charlie Hunnam, Charlie Day & Rinko Kikuchi) take the fight to the invading alien force lurking in the depths of the Pacific Ocean. Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes -- a washed up former pilot and an untested trainee -- who now stand as earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.

Based on Cornelia Funke's bestselling children's novel, this timeless tale of imagination and adventure centers on a young girl whose father (The Mummy's Brendan Fraser) has a secret ability to bring characters from books to life when he reads them aloud. programme.desc: Much to his dismay, Adam is placed in the advanced class with the dorky super-smart kids.

programme.desc: Hysteria breaks out at CDMS when Slips comes in with a case of 'the sheds' and everyone thinks he's contagious.

programme.desc: Jake brings a shiny glass ball (actually a doorknob) to school.

programme.title: Paw Patrol: The Movie

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.13: Drone On
programme.desc: Ben and Gwen engage in a highly competitive paper airplane war, but when alien-tech drones bombard the Rustbucket, they must work together to foil the aerial attack and find out who's behind it.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.14: Safari Sa'Bad
programme.desc: Ben takes a detour on a jungle cruise during a trip to Adrenaworld West and finds himself hunted by the evil Tim Buktu. Ben must outwit Tim Buktu if he wants to make it off the theme park ride alive.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.15: The Nature Of Things
programme.desc: The Tennyson trio uncovers Steam Smythe's steam-powered generator during a sightseeing trip at the Geyser Gulch National Park, and must shut it down before it overloads the power grid.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.16: Assault On Pancake Palace
programme.desc: When Gwen enters a pancake-eating contest at the world-famous Pancake Palace, Ben spots the Bugg Brothers and must stop them before they obtain an endless supply of what fuels their creations.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.17: Bomzobo Lives
programme.desc: Max takes a driving test to renew his licence, but when a disguised Zombozo hijacks the role of instructor, Ben becomes an alien to stop the evil clown and save their family road trip.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.18: The Sound And The Furry
programme.desc: As Team Tennyson leaves the Frozen Man Festival, Lord Decibel takes centre stage to threaten the festival-goers, vowing to create an avalanche if his ransom isn't paid.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.19: King Koil
programme.desc: Ben and Gwen spend the day volunteering at Repto Ranch and come face-to-face with King Koil. They need to overcome their fear of snakes quickly if they are to defeat the slithery baddie.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.20: Reststop Roustabout
programme.desc: With the Rustbucket stopped on the Midwest roadside, Ben locks himself inside with his tablet as Max and Gwen enjoy the great outdoors, until Team Tennyson is pulled into a wild Jack-a-Lope chase.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.21: That'S The Stuff
programme.desc: While on a tour at a space museum, Ben's excitement multiplies when he learns that some recently discovered 'space stuff' is being examined inside the museum's lab.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.22: Half-Sies
programme.desc: During a trip to the Lake of the Ozarks, Ben and Gwen squabble over Ben's 'half-birthday' celebration, but when Max gets word of a suspicious rockslide, the cousins must put aside their differences.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.23: Xingo'S Back
programme.desc: Left to entertain himself as Max takes a well-deserved nap, Ben stumbles upon a Xingo arcade game and goes OE-Shock Rock to power it up, but it, unfortunately, receives too much juice.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.24: Bounty Ball
programme.desc: While Gwen listens to a lecture on the Transcontinental Railroad, Ben sneaks away to the gift shop. When the Bounty Hunters appear and corner Ben, Gwen must use what she learnt to help him escape.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.25: Fear The Fogg
programme.desc: As Max attempts to get Ben and Gwen to the Four Corners Monument before sunset, an ominous fog bank engulfs the roadway and forces Max to drive at a snail's pace.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.26: The Charm Offensive
programme.desc: After Ben gets too much publicity for his alien-antics in Fort Knox, a jealous Gwen feels unappreciated and looks to ease her pain with ice cream. She is soon confronted by Charmcaster.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2 Ep.27: Super-Villain Team-Up
programme.desc: After a lull in alien antics, Ben suggests to Max and Gwen that he might be a better hero if he went solo. Vilgax enlists the help of Zombozo to build a giant hypno-mechanism to mesmerise the world.

programme.title: Victorious S1 Ep.108: Robarazzi
programme.desc: Tori suggests Robbie capture videos of students' everyday lives to increase his blog traffic, but when the camera is turned on Tori, she asks him to stop. Only Robbie doesn't and Tori realizes she's created a monster.

programme.title: Sam & Cat S1 Ep.112: #BabysittingCommercial
programme.desc: To boost their babysitting business, Sam and Cat make a commercial that features Dice's beloved dog. A family recognizes the dog and seeks legal ownership, claiming the dog belongs to them.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S2 Ep.206: The Rejects
programme.desc: When Leo, Mikey, and Raph are captured by the mad scientist Jordan Perry and his Monster Mutanimals, Donnie must stop a mutant invasion on Staten Island and save everyone from the terrifying creation known as Mutant Omega!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S2 Ep.207: Rise of the Night Ninja
programme.desc: When Leo accidentally saves a subway station full of innocent people, he's inspired to take on a life of crime-fighting vigilantism as the Night Ninja! But has he met his match with the villainous La Fleur and her gang of dognappers?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 Ep.181: License to Milkshake / Squid Baby
programme.desc: SpongeBob learns his milkshake license has expired, and is forced to go back to the milkshake academy. // Squidward hits his head and reverts to being a baby, and it's up to SpongeBob and Patrick to take care of him.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 Ep.182: Little Yellow Book / Bumper to Bumper
programme.desc: Squidward finds SpongeBob's diary, and starts reading it out loud in the Krusty Krab. // SpongeBob once again fails his driving test, forcing Mrs. Puff to think outside the box--and off the road.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 Ep.183: Eek, An Urchin! / Squid's Defense
programme.desc: SpongeBob finds a nasty sea urchin living in the Krusty Krab, and tries everything to force it out. // After getting his groceries stolen, Squidward convinces SpongeBob and Sandy to teach him karate.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 Ep.123: Snapshot slip up! / The Park Beast
programme.desc: The Marsups are photographed by a street mapper car, so the twins must find a way to delete the photos! // Rosa thinks there's a Beast loose in the park, when she catches a glimpse of the Marsups.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 Ep.124: Twins in Charge / Sticky tails
programme.desc: Gran Gran is out and things get complicated when a hygiene inspector arrives at the Chahuta. // The Marsupilamis end up stuck together due to getting sticky sap from the Chahuta tree on their tails.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S4 Ep.409: In a Space Pickle / Stare Wars
programme.desc: Quasar uses Patrick to communicate with the dumbest aliens in the universe. // Patrick and GrandPat have a staring contest to compete for the last lick of a baking spoon.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S4 Ep.410: Safety Worst / De-Pat-ment Store
programme.desc: After yet another Star house disaster, the fire marshal forces Patrick to watch a safety training video. // Patrick fails his way up the corporate ladder at Upturn's mall.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 Ep.122: Dad's Stache Stash
programme.desc: Cecil shows Patrick his mustache collection.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 Ep.317: Delivery of Doom / My Father the Boat
programme.desc: SpongeBob is challenged by E.V.I.L. to make a delivery to their secret lair in 10 minutes or less. // When Mr. Krabs gets trapped inside of Pearl's new boat, he must pretend to be its engine to avoid being caught.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S1 Ep.108: For Your Spies Only
programme.desc: Max and Phoebe attend Parent-Teacher Night, leaving Chloe and friends home without adult supervision. When Jinx finds the Air Lair, he believes spies are targeting the school, and his meddling puts the Thundermans' school jobs at risk.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 Ep.216: Let's Go to the Movies!
programme.desc: ShoutOut has a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to sell a movie to Hollywood bigshot Deuce Van Nuys, but when her mind goes blank under the pressure, the rest of Danger Force pitch in and share their own epic--and epically bad--movie ideas.

programme.title: Henry Danger S4 Ep.411: Toon in for Danger
programme.desc: When Henry and Ray get a copy of the new Kid Danger and Captain Man cartoon and see that it's horrible, they must hurry to fix the cartoon before the big premiere party.

programme.title: The Loud House S2 Ep.204: Suite and Sour / Back in Black
programme.desc: After Mom and Dad win a trip to a resort, they decide to take the kids - but only because they promised to behave. // When Lucy gets a crush on a 'regular and normal' boy, her sisters give her a makeover.

programme.title: The Loud House S2 Ep.205: Making the Grade / Vantastic Voyage
programme.desc: When Lincoln's four-year-old sister, Lisa, gets put into his 5th grade class, his social standing is at stake! // Sick of their family van always falling apart, the kids decide to try and trick Dad into buying a cool new van.

programme.title: The Loud House S3 Ep.314: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: When Lana learns her favorite fish are in jeopardy of losing their home to construction she springs into action.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S11 Ep.229: Doodle Dimension / Moving Bubble Bass
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Patrick become trapped in an alternate dimension where anything they draw comes to life. // SpongeBob and Patrick help Bubble Bass move out of his mother's basement.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S11 Ep.230: High Sea Diving / Bottle Burglars
programme.desc: SpongeBob wants to be the first sponge to dive all the way up to the surface of the ocean! // When SpongeBob and Squidward accidentally let Plankton steal the secret formula, it's up to them to steal it back!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 Ep.280: Wallhalla
programme.desc: SpongeBob discovers a crazed castaway living in his walls.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 Ep.283: Ma and Pa's Big Hurrah / Yellow Pavement
programme.desc: When SpongeBob's parents come to visit, their thirst for thrills comes as a big surprise. // You'll learn all you need to get your boating license in this educational driving film.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 Ep.256: SpongeBob in Randomland / SpongeBob's Bad Habit
programme.desc: SpongeBob and Squidward take a delivery to a dreaded town where the laws of logic no longer apply. // SpongeBob can't stop biting his nails, but he also can't figure out why!

programme.title: The Loud House S6 Ep.617: Cheer Pressure / Stroke of Luck
programme.desc: Lori becomes a celebrity at school when she hits a hole-in-one on a notoriously difficult course. // The cheerleaders challenge Lynn and her teammates to a 'cheer off' when Lynn dismisses them as athletes.

programme.title: The Loud House S6 Ep.618: Space Jammed / Crown and Dirty
programme.desc: Annoyed by Leni's intrusive babysitting, Lisa accidentally blasts herself and Todd into space. // Lola tries to whip Mom into tip-top pageant condition for a Mother-Daughter pageant.

programme.title: The Loud House S4 Ep.407: Present Tense / Any Given Sundae
programme.desc: Convinced that their scrapbook isn't good enough for Dad's birthday, the Loud kids seek out the perfect gift. // Lily hears the parents mention ice cream if the kids are good, so she uses baby smarts to avert sibling disasters

programme.title: The Loud House S4 Ep.408: Can't Hardly Wait / A Mutt Above
programme.desc: Lori takes a waitressing job at Dad's restaurant, but it turns out that serving is harder than she anticipated. // Spurred on by a classmate's mocking about Charles, Lana decides to train him to compete in a local dog show.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 Ep.309: Bad Luck Bob / The Sandman Cometh
programme.desc: SpongeBob experiences a bad luck streak when his lucky tie clip suddenly goes missing. // When Patrick can't fall asleep, he seeks assistance from the Sandman.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 Ep.310: Biscuit Ballyhoo / Student Driver Survivor
programme.desc: After the Science Scouts begin selling biscuits to fund a trip to Mars, Mr. Krabs joins the ring and turns it into a competition. // When a competitor threatens to shut down Mrs. Puff's boating school, she must rely on SpongeBob to stay in business.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 Ep.204: Mutiny on the Krusty / The Whole Tooth
programme.desc: When a storm sweeps the Krusty Krab away, its crew and customers will need a crazed Krabs to lead them back home. // Patrick’s last baby tooth needs to come out, but he’s afraid to let it go.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S10 Ep.206: Unreal Estate / Code Yellow
programme.desc: When SpongeBob thinks he's allergic to his pineapple, Squidward offers to help find him a new home. // Squidward is getting a nose job at the local hospital, and SpongeBob tags along as moral support.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S5 Ep.503: Braggin' Slayer / Scaredy Pat
programme.desc: In Hamdonia, Prince Shmeat and Tofu Todd embark on a quest to defeat the Maw. // After learning what stage fright is, Patrick fears his own audience.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S5 Ep.504: Make Yourself Pat Home / Accidentally in Love
programme.desc: Patrick overstays his welcome at the SquarePants home. // GrandPat attempts to injure himself for Nurse Helga's attention.

programme.title: The Loud House S3 Ep.305: City Slickers / Fool Me Twice
programme.desc: Lori and Lincoln visit the city. Lori struggles to be a city girl and Lincoln finds Ronnie Anne has changed. // The family has a new plan to dodge Luan's April Fool's Day pranking: stunt doubles

programme.title: The Loud House S3 Ep.306: Net Gains / Pipe Dreams
programme.desc: Lynn desperately wants to win a basketball championship but gets drafted onto a terrible team. // Mom and Dad are sick of waiting in the long bathroom line so they decide to build a secret bathroom.

programme.title: The Loud House S5 Ep.511: School of Shock / Elecshunned
programme.desc: Lisa takes over her first-grade classroom and learns that there's more to teaching than just knowing facts. // Leni goes toe-to-toe with the Mayor in a city-wide Royal Woods election.

programme.title: The Loud House S9 Ep.911: Hologram Jam
programme.desc: To avoid his responsibilities, Lincoln uses Lisa's hologram device to make it appear like he's doing all of his tasks.

programme.title: Kids' Choice Awards 2026 S Ep.:

programme.title: Danger Force S2 Ep.204: A Henry Among Us

programme.title: Danger Force S2 Ep.205: Dude, Where's My Man Buggy?
programme.desc: When Danger Force borrows Ray's beloved Man Buggy without permission it falls into the hands of criminals Stupid Jeff and The Toddler. Now the team must track it down and get it back before Ray finds out.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 Ep.523: A Tale of Two Pipers
programme.desc: Henry gets an unexpected visitor claiming to be from the future. When a boy-robot killing machine steps onto the scene, The Gang must find a way to save everyone from an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: That Girl Lay Lay S2 Ep.218: Bring It On
programme.desc: Trying out for the cheerleading squad, Lay Lay and Sadie add their own twists to the routine, but learn that standing out doesn't always work when trying to fit into a team.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S11 Ep.219: Man Ray Returns / Larry the Floor Manager

programme.desc: Humdinger tries to swipe the florist's Easter decorations and winds up on a runaway wagon with Mayor Goodway. // Mysterious Alien Easter Eggs cause trouble in Adventure Bay, the Paw Patrol and their Alien Friend will team up to catch them.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S11 Ep.1104: Pups Save the Missing Bone-Stone
programme.desc: The Museum has a brand-new exhibit: the Emerald Bone-Stone! But when the precious bone goes missing.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.121: The Crew Fixes The Talent Show Stage / The Crew Builds Instruments
programme.desc: When Speed Meister sabotages the stage for the town Talent Show, the pups use Motor's talent to save the day. // Sierra Sparkle is coming to sing for Builder Cove Day! But when the band's instruments break, Rubble & Crew have a construction solution.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.122: The Crew Builds A Giant Dam / The Crew Builds A Squirrel-Proof Farm
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew are on the job to save Builder Cove after a rainstorm threatens to flood the town. // Rubble and Motor come up with crafty construction solutions to fix Farmer Zoe's squirrel problem before the Farm Fair.

programme.title: DORA S5 Ep.511: Super Perrito / Benny and the Pets
programme.desc: When Perrito puts on a cape that gives him superpowers, Dora, Boots, and "Super Perrito" zoom around the rainforest saving friends in need! // Dora and Boots help their friend Benny find his perfect pet among all the adorable pets at Pick-a-Pet Park.

programme.title: DORA S5 Ep.512: Dora and Diego Save The Whales / Turtle Trouble
programme.desc: Dora, Boots, Diego, and Baby Jaguar venture into the sea to help a baby whale named Huicho find his lost whale family. // Dora, Boots, Diego, and Baby Jaguar help a baby sea turtle named Tati get home to the ocean.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.125: Barbabravo Is Not Feeling Well / Be Patient Barbabravo...
programme.desc: Following a misadventure, Barbabravo is unable to transform at all. The whole family unites to help him. // Barbabravo can't stay put and is unable to focus one an activity for very long. Barbalala offers to teach him control. Will she succeed?

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.126: The Seven Foods / The Perfect Portrait
programme.desc: The Barbababies think their food can make them change colours and shapes. They decide to find the right food for each of them. // Barbabeau lacks inspiration, he can't create anymore. The whole family helps by suggesting new subjects to paint.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.201: Moving Mission / Barbabright's Invention
programme.desc: During a walk, the Barbapapa family discovers a megalith. // Barbabright has a stroke of genius: the invention of the "BAM".

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.202: Princess For A Day / Barbabeau's Adventure
programme.desc: Barbabelle proudly announces to her family that she wants to become a princess. // Barbabravo is moping with boredom, his brothers and sisters are all busy and no one wants to play with him.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.203: Summer Camp I / Summer Camp II
programme.desc: Barbapapa and Barbamama have announced to their dear barbababies that they are going on a trip to Easter Island. // The Barbababies, the twins, and Mr. Strict set sail on "Thésée", a magnificent sailboat.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.212: The Crew Builds A Ballpark / The Crew Builds A Surf Bridge
programme.desc: When Rubble's favorite baseball star Aaron Judge can't get out of town to the home run derby, Rubble & Crew build a stadium to hold the derby right in Builder Cove! // Surf's up for Rubble & Crew! Well, if they can get over the super hot sand, it is.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.213: The Crew Builds A Reuse-It Station / The Crew Builds A Duck Bridge
programme.desc: When Speed Meister builds his own station for reusing trash, the pups have to clean up the mess all over Builder Cove. // After a baby duckling follows them home, Rubble & Crew use their construction know-how to bring the duckling back to its home.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S14 Ep.1401: Pups Stop the Garboni / Pups Save the Porcupine
programme.desc: Farmer Al's new machine, the "Garboni" goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip! // The Paw Patrol have to catch a trouble making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S9 Ep.901: Liberty Makes a New Friend / Pups Save the Pup Pup Boogie Contest
programme.desc: Liberty mistakenly brings a bear into town, thinking it's someone's pet. She must fix her mistake and rescue Chickaletta. // Francois' hot-air balloon goes out of control before the Pup Pup Boogie Contest. The Pups, with Liberty, race to the rescue.

programme.title: Deer Squad S4 Ep.419: Quake Crystal Quest / Yes Day Disaster
programme.desc: Jade and Bobbi seek the Quake Crystal to calm the seas, but it is guarded by Ellie the giant eel. // The twins enjoy yes day with Uncle Steel, but when he says yes to being bad things go wrong.

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You S3 Ep.302: Blue's Dino Clues
programme.desc: It's a prehistoric game of Blue's Clues when a mysterious dinosaur egg falls out of the skidoo frame and starts to hatch! We figure out what kind of dinosaur is inside the egg so we can reunite the egg with their family.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.106: Spaceland / New Rocket / Babysitting
programme.desc: Tim, Tommy and Tia get lost at a play centre. // Tim tries to find a new rocket that's perfect for him. // Tim tries to bend all the rules when Terri comes to babysit.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S4 Ep.413: The Crew Builds A Sporting Goods Store / The Crew Plays Construction Vehicle Soccer
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew help Coach Karima and Shopkeeper Shelley team up to open Builder Cove's first ever sporting goods store. // The pups move a giant watermelon for Farmer Zoe. But when squirrels get in the way, Rubble & Crew have to play to save the day!

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.105: Princess and the Pirate Puppy / Caracol Cove

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You S4 Ep.407: Night at the Bluseum
programme.desc: It's the night of the big Bluseum opening, and just as Josh unveils Blue's masterpiece, he discovers that it's missing! He must play Blue's Clues to crack this caper and get Blue's painting back!

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.101: Lucky Croc / Sleepover Croc
programme.desc: Daisy and Mr. Crocodile search for a lucky item to help them win a bike raffle. // When Mr. Crocodile can't fall asleep at his first sleepover, Daisy helps him figure out why.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.205: Ah! My Beautiful Castle / The Sand Is Running Away

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.206: The Birth / The Revelation

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.203: Beach Scanner / Tidy / Pets

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.206: Roadtrip / Tickets / Talent Show
programme.desc: The Rex family go on a road trip through the galaxy to get to Rocket World // Tim & Kai compete to get Terri's spare Space-Land ticket // Tim, Tia & Tommy decide to put on a talent show, but then they can't decide who should go first...

programme.desc: Tim tries to return a lost walky talky to it's owner. // Tim and Tommy go on a camping trip, but soon disagree on what to do first. // When Tim finds Blobert, an old toy, it brings out the monster in him.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.102: Vinny
programme.desc: Tim fakes it to prove he's just as cool as Kai's cousin.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S2 Ep.218: Pups Save an Adventure / Pups Save a Surprise

programme.desc: The Barbababies are bored, the rain is preventing them from playing outside. // Barbibul has created a clever decoder capable of translating the cries of animals.

Today an actress trained at the Conservatoire d'art dramatique de Québec, she moves between stage, screen and artistic engagement, driven by a deeply multicultural journey.

programme.title: Le Match Dans Le Match
programme.desc: A key figure from the world of sport looks back at a particular competition, a career, an outstanding moment.

programme.title: Le Téléjournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: A journey rich in flavour through the regions and their terroirs, exploring local specialities and meeting the artisans perpetuating their age-old culinary traditions. An opportunity to stop off in the kitchen of a talented chef to prepare an emblematic regional recipe.

programme.title: Hep Taxi !
programme.desc: In town or in the countryside, day or night, Jérôme Colin, the presenter-taxi driver leads his prestigious customer on a four-wheel journey conducive to secrets.

programme.title: Les Alpes Suisses, Entre Traditions Et Superstitions Ep.3: The 'men of the forest' of Andermatt
programme.desc: Every year, villagers wearing jute bags gather at the edge of the forest and wait for the church bells to toll. Then, ringing cow bells and blowing goat horns, the 'men of the forest' ('Woldmanndli') begin their descent to Andermatt.

programme.title: Tendance Xxi
programme.desc: French creativity is booming in the fields of fashion, crafts, design, beauty and gastronomy. 'Tendance XXI' showcases a know-how that evolves in tune with the times, sometimes even anticipating them.

programme.title: L'Épicerie
programme.desc: The place to be for all those who are interested in what they put on their plates and all things relating to food. The programme: reports, surveys, taste tests, test benches, answers to questions from television viewers, including advice and simple but effective tricks.

programme.title: Questions Pour Un Champion
programme.desc: A general knowledge quiz.

programme.title: Dîner À La Ferme - L'Esprit De Famille Ep.5: Aline Luisier (Valais)
programme.desc: Aline Luisier is the daughter of Marie-Gabrielle, from the 2010 season. She is a farmer, like her sister and three brothers. In summer, she is responsible for a summer farm, looking after a herd of 110 cattle. She is also the head of a pack of twenty sled dogs. In winter, she's a musher.

programme.title: Parlons Éco
programme.desc: TV5MONDE's economic news bulletin, presented by Vicky Bogaert. "Parlons éco" analyses today's major trends and interviews the men and women who are starting businesses, innovating and imagining the economy of tomorrow.

programme.title: Un Pays, Un Livre
programme.desc: 30 authors to discover (or rediscover)! A journey through contemporary French-language literature presented by Augustin Trapenard.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Jean-Jacques Goldman - Le Grand Concert De La Francophonie
programme.desc: On August 25, 2025, the Agora du Vieux-Port de Québec welcomed numerous international stars for a moving tribute to Jean-Jacques Goldman, celebrating his 75th birthday and 50 years of his career. A celebration held without the artist himself, but carried by the emotion and talent of the guest performers.

programme.title: Opj Ep.17: Jane Doe (1)
programme.desc: The body of a tortured woman is found on a beach. It appears that she drowned in a swimming pool and was thrown in the sea post-mortem. As the team struggle to identify her, a couple turn up at the station.

programme.title: Opj Ep.18: Jane Doe (2)
programme.desc: The couple are accused of torturing their babysitter. Tahia puts herself in the victim's place to understand how this happened but inadvertently becomes the ideal target.

programme.desc: The Vibe is a 30-minute TV show that runs daily on weekdays on CGTN. The content focuses on exciting new trends, fashion, and cultural topics across a range of disciplines both in China and abroad. The host presents various culture-related topics in a fun way while also doing some in-depth analysis to give viewers a fuller picture as to what is happening, and why it matters.

Inheritors is a multi-media product from CGTN that shines a light on China’s rich Intangible Cultural Heritage. Each 30-minute TV edition is hosted by a long-term expatriate in China who has a unique understanding of the country’s culture. He or she will introduce viewers to people who are dedicating their lives to its protection, inheritance, innovation, development and promotion.

programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN's Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live.

A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
